name: zrndr_submit_poly_with_span_list
description: zRndr_SubmitPolyWithSpanList queues overwrite or transparent software span-list polygons and immediately rasterizes opaque non-overwrite polygons.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification through the zrndr_submit_poly_with_span_list target still fails: 415 unmasked mismatches, 76 relocation bytes masked, 1 trailing VC NOP byte trimmed, Binary Ninja body 544 bytes, VC object symbol 432 bytes.
